summary: Completed comprehensive testing of multi-tenant e-commerce platform. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate), but frontend has significant integration issues with API endpoints and authentication flow.

critical_bugs.issue: After successful login, users are not redirected to their appropriate dashboards (/admin for super_admin, /dashboard for shop_owner)
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot access protected admin/dashboard areas even with valid credentials

critical_bugs.issue: Frontend trying to access non-existent legacy endpoints: /api/products, /api/categories, /api/cart, /api/wishlist
critical_bugs.impact: Homepage fails to load products, cart/wishlist functionality broken

integration_issues.issue: HomePage tries to fetch from /api/products but backend only has shop-specific endpoints like /api/shop/{slug}/products
CartContext and WishlistContext use endpoints (/api/cart, /api/wishlist) that don't exist in current backend

ui_bugs.issue: React key warnings - duplicate keys for products (prod-001, prod-002, etc.)
Missing aria-describedby warnings for DialogContent components

passed_tests: Super Admin Create Shop Owner API
Public Storefront Shop by Slug API

success_percentage.frontend: 60% (basic functionality works, but critical auth/API integration issues)

critical_fixes_needed: Fix authentication redirect flow - after login, redirect super_admin to /admin and shop_owner to /dashboard
Update frontend API endpoints to match current backend structure
Replace legacy endpoints (/api/products, /api/categories, /api/cart, /api/wishlist) with multi-tenant equivalents
Fix HomePage to use shop-specific product endpoints or create a general products endpoint
Implement proper cart/wishlist functionality for the multi-tenant structure
medium_priority: Fix React key warnings by ensuring unique keys for product lists
Add proper aria-describedby attributes to Dialog components
architecture_notes: Current backend is fully multi-tenant with shop-specific endpoints
Frontend still uses old single-tenant API structure
Need to decide: modify frontend to be fully multi-tenant OR add legacy endpoints to backend
